# KimRosil App Studio - Full Application Specifications & System Reference

> Complete technical documentation, calculation models, and privacy specifications for the entire KimRosil App Studio suite.

## Studio Technical Profile
- **Founder & Lead Developer**: Eliakim Rosil
- **Platform Target**: Android (Minimum SDK: 24 / Android 7.0; Target SDK: 33+ / Android 13+)
- **Development Paradigm**: Pure Native Android Framework (Java + XML and Kotlin + XML)
- **Compilation Hardware**: Lenovo Legion Y70 (Qualcomm Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, ARM64 / aarch64 native compilation in Termux)
- **Network & Privacy Guarantee**: 100% Offline-First. No internet permission requested where possible. Zero analytics, zero ad SDKs, zero cloud telemetry.
- **Primary Domain**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/
- **Catalog API**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/apps.json
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/eliakimrosil/kimrosil-app-studio

---

## AuraFocus (`aurafocus-minimalist-pomodoro-ambient-sound`)
- **Category**: Productivity
- **Tagline**: Offline distraction-free timer with embedded ambient white noise & AMOLED dark theme.
- **Landing Page**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/aurafocus-minimalist-pomodoro-ambient-sound/
- **Direct APK CDN**: https://github.com/eliakimrosil/kim-android-apps/releases/download/v1.0.0-aurafocus-minimalist-pomodoro-ambient-sound/aurafocus-minimalist-pomodoro-ambient-sound.apk

- **Architecture**: 100% Offline Native Android (Zero Telemetry, Zero Third-Party SDKs)
- **Compatibility**: Android 7.0+ (ARM64 / ARMv7)

### Detailed Overview & Capabilities
AuraFocus is a minimalist, offline-first productivity timer designed for deep work, study sessions, and uninterrupted flow. Eliminate digital fatigue with a streamlined workflow that respects your attention and device resources. Key Features: • Flexible Interval Timing: Customize work intervals, short breaks, and long breaks based on the proven Pomodoro technique to maintain consistent productivity. • Curated Ambient Audio: Blend calming, high-fidelity soundscapes including rain, forest, white noise, and gentle streams directly on your device. • Offline and Private: All countdowns, session logs, and audio playback run entirely on-device. No accounts, cloud sign-ins, or telemetry trackers are required. • Native Android Integration: Control sessions seamlessly via interactive Home Screen widgets, persistent status notifications, and a dedicated Quick Settings tile without opening the app. • Minimal Battery Impact: Engineered with a lightweight local architecture to ensure zero unnecessary background battery drain. • Clean Statistics: Review completed intervals, total focus hours, and daily streaks through intuitive, privacy-conscious charts. Whether preparing for exams, managing coding sprints, or practicing structured reading, AuraFocus delivers a quiet, distraction-free environment tailored to your daily routine.


Data Safety & Offline Privacy Guarantee:
- 100% Offline: This application operates entirely on your device without requiring an active internet connection.
- Zero Data Collection: We do not collect, monitor, track, store, or transmit any personal identifiable information (PII), device identifiers, or usage telemetry.
- No Accounts or Subscriptions: Enjoy complete utility with zero account creation, logins, or hidden recurring fees.
- Local Storage Only: All items, history, and preferences are retained strictly within on-device sandboxed storage.

## Caulk Bead & Skin Sentinel (`caulk-bead-skin-sentinel`)
- **Category**: Tools & Utilities
- **Tagline**: Offline workshop and tiling assistant tracking caulk tooling pot life and cure phases right from Quick Settings.
- **Landing Page**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/caulk-bead-skin-sentinel/
- **Direct APK CDN**: https://github.com/eliakimrosil/kimrosil-app-studio/releases/download/v1.0.0-caulk-bead-skin-sentinel/caulk-bead-skin-sentinel.apk

- **Architecture**: 100% Offline Native Android (Zero Telemetry, Zero Third-Party SDKs)
- **Compatibility**: Android 7.0+ (ARM64 / ARMv7)

### Detailed Overview & Capabilities
Caulk Bead & Skin Sentinel is an offline utility designed for contractors, painters, and remodelers to calculate accurate sealant tooling windows and cure schedules based on ambient working conditions. Applying silicone, polyurethane, and acrylic caulking requires precise timing. Premature tooling tears half-skinned beads, while delayed tooling ruins smooth joint finishes and water seals. Standard timers do not account for environmental changes. Caulk Bead & Skin Sentinel factors in local ambient temperature and relative humidity to estimate skin-over thresholds and rain-ready exposure windows accurately. Engineered for fast, distraction-free use on the job site: • Environmental Compensation: Calculates estimated tooling open times and cure duration based on user-entered ambient temperature and relative humidity levels. • Chemistry Presets: Profiles for 100% silicone, hybrid polymer, acrylic latex, polyurethane, and specialty sealants. • Quick Settings Tile: Start and monitor active bead timers directly from the Android Quick Settings shade without navigating menus. • Live Bead Progress: Ongoing status alerts provide clear progress updates, audible signals, and distinct vibration patterns tailored for noisy jobsites. • Multi-Joint Tracking: Monitor tooling deadlines across multiple active joints and surfaces simultaneously. • Zero Accounts or Cloud Logins: Fully functional without an internet connection, account creation, or external servers. • Privacy Respecting: No background analytics, third-party advertising frameworks, or unnecessary system permissions. Ensure clean, compliant, and watertight sealant joints on every finish.

### Detailed Overview & Capabilities
ChillThaw helps home cooks and professional chefs defrost meat safely and accurately using established USDA food safety standards. Improper thawing risks foodborne bacterial growth in the food safety danger zone (40°F to 140°F / 4°C to 60°C). ChillThaw replaces guesswork with thermodynamic time estimation based on cut thickness, weight, meat type, and defrost method. KEY CAPABILITIES • Accurate Thaw Calculations: Precise defrost durations for beef, poultry, pork, seafood, and lamb. • Multiple Thawing Methods: Calculate safe schedules for refrigerator thawing, cold water baths with reminder intervals, or microwave cycles. • Food Safety Countdown: Track USDA bacterial safety thresholds with live timers. • Android System Integration: Check ongoing progress from your notification drawer, home screen glance widget, or Quick Settings tile. • Offline Operation: Calculate kitchen defrost times anywhere without an internet connection. • Clean User Experience: Zero intrusive interstitial interruptions while cooking. SUPPORTED CUTS & METHODS • Refrigerator Thawing: Multi-day countdowns for whole turkeys, roasts, and large primal cuts. • Cold Water Submersion: 30-minute water refresh alert reminders. • Safety Threshold Warnings: Direct guidance on maximum room temperature exposure limits. ChillThaw operates completely offline without mandatory account registration or personal data collection.

## ClaimSlip (`claim-slip`)
- **Category**: FINANCE
- **Tagline**: Offline warranty tracker and receipt ledger for appliances and gadgets.
- **Landing Page**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/claim-slip/
- **Direct APK CDN**: https://github.com/eliakimrosil/kimrosil-app-studio/releases/download/v1.0.0-claim-slip/claim-slip.apk
- **Privacy Policy**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/claim-slip/privacy.html
- **Architecture**: 100% Offline Native Android (Zero Telemetry, Zero Third-Party SDKs)
- **Compatibility**: Android 7.0+ (ARM64 / ARMv7)

### Detailed Overview & Capabilities
When major home appliances, power tools, or electronic gadgets fail, buyers scramble to find receipts only to discover faded thermal slips or missing paperwork. ClaimSlip solves this problem with an offline-first warranty registry and high-contrast receipt archive.

KEY UTILITIES:

• 100% OFFLINE PRIVACY
No accounts, no cloud sync, and zero tracking. All warranty metadata, receipts, serial numbers, and claim details remain strictly on your local device.

• THERMAL RECEIPT DIGITAL VAULT
Save paper receipts and thermal store slips directly to your local registry. High-contrast display filters enhance faded or faint thermal print so proof-of-purchase remains readable years later when making a manufacturer claim.

• LIVE WARRANTY COUNTDOWN LEDGER
Instantly see how many days remain on every warranty. Filter by Active, Expiring Soon (within 30 days), or Expired. Receive local alerts before coverage lapses so you can schedule timely service or extended claims.

• COMPLETE PURCHASE PROOF RECORDS
Record model numbers, serial numbers, purchase dates, store retailers, and prices in clean 2-column telemetry cards. Tap to copy serial numbers directly when on support calls.

• FAST SEARCH & FILTERING
Find items instantly by appliance name, brand, store, or serial number. Sort by expiration date to keep upcoming deadlines front and center.

• LIGHTWEIGHT & RESOURCE EFFICIENT
Zero heavy libraries, instant cold start, and minimal storage footprint. Built purely with native Android components.

Tap Share in any app, select ClipScrub, and forward sanitized content to your intended recipient. • Zero Network Permissions: Operates completely offline on your device. ## CombGauge (`comb-gauge`)
- **Category**: TOOLS & UTILITIES / ENGINEERING
- **Tagline**: Offline wet film thickness and dry film coat calculator for industrial spray painters
- **Landing Page**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/comb-gauge/
- **Direct APK CDN**: https://github.com/eliakimrosil/kimrosil-app-studio/releases/download/v1.0.1-comb-gauge/comb-gauge.apk
- **Privacy Policy**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/comb-gauge/privacy.html
- **Architecture**: 100% Offline Native Android (Zero Telemetry, Zero Third-Party SDKs)
- **Compatibility**: Android 7.0+ (ARM64 / ARMv7)

### Detailed Overview & Capabilities
CombGauge is a field calculator designed for industrial spray coaters, marine painters, and protective coating inspectors who need fast, accurate film thickness verification on the job. Applying coatings without real-time thickness validation risks costly failures including runs, sags, mud cracking, and solvent entrapment. CombGauge converts raw notched wet-film comb measurements directly into specified Dry Film Thickness (DFT) while accounting for solvent evaporation, thinner cut percentages, and surface roughness absorption. BUILT FOR INDUSTRIAL FIELD CONDITIONS • 100% Offline Capability: Operates entirely without cellular reception or Wi-Fi, making it reliable inside ballast tanks, ship hulls, fabrication yards, and blast booths. • No Accounts or Cloud Sync: Instant access with zero sign-in barriers, trackers, or background data consumption. • Bidirectional Calculations: Determine target Wet Film Thickness (WFT) from specified DFT, or calculate predicted cured DFT from a live comb reading. • Thinner Dilution Compensation: Adjust calculations accurately for reduction percentages added during field mixing. • Surface Profile Correction: Factor in blast profile anchor patterns and substrate absorption to prevent dry spray and under-thickness non-conformance. • Dual Unit Support: Switch seamlessly between metric (microns/µm) and imperial (mils) measurement systems. CombGauge delivers practical, accurate coating calculations directly to field operators, supporting quality control compliance and reducing rework across structural steel, marine, and industrial maintenance projects.


Data Safety & Offline Privacy Guarantee:

Fabricating single, double, or bubble flares requires exact measurements. An undersized flare risks blow-out under operating pressures exceeding 400 PSI in modern refrigerants or 1500 PSI in hydraulic brake systems. An oversized flare risks thread galling, uneven seating, and metal fatigue. FlareGage eliminates guesswork with reliable dimensional standards calculated for copper, aluminum, and steel tubing. Designed for real-world mechanical environments, FlareGage operates fully offline with instant access controls, allowing quick visual checks without navigating slow menus or complex charts. Ensure proper seal integrity on every brake line, mini-split lineset, and refrigeration circuit with FlareGage.

### Detailed Overview & Capabilities

Direct Ingest Architecture
KR Live Studio connects straight to your specified streaming endpoint using hardware-accelerated MediaCodec H.264 video encoding and MediaProjection capture. Because streams transmit directly between your device and your chosen ingest server without third-party cloud intermediaries or relay proxies, your transmission latency is minimized and your broadcast credentials remain secure.

Core Features:
• Hardware Video Encoding: MediaCodec H.264/AVC processing engineered for efficient real-time compression and battery balance.
• Direct RTMP & RTMPS Protocol: Native streaming engine supporting standard port 1935 and TLS-encrypted port 443 endpoints with auto-reconnection and exponential backoff.
• Internal Game Audio & Dual-Mixer: Android 10+ AudioPlaybackCapture for pristine game sound, mixed in real-time with linear PCM mic commentary.
• One-Tap Privacy Shield: Instantly detach screen projection and mute audio without severing the RTMP socket or resetting stream uptime.
• Dynamic Keyframe Recovery: Automatically requests IDR sync frames from MediaCodec upon congestion packet drops to eliminate visual artifacting.
• Multi-Platform Stream Key Vault: Save and recall distinct stream keys for YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Kick, Facebook, and Custom servers.
• Clean Floating Facecam: Draggable PiP camera overlay with Squircle/Circle shape masking and auto-hiding controls.
• Hardware Telemetry HUD: Real-time SoC thermal state monitoring, network health gauge, live bitrate, FPS, and dropped frame telemetry.
• Tactile Controls: Clear bitrate adjustments, resolution selection (1080p, 720p, 480p), and visual audio VU indicators.

Permissions & Usage:
• Screen Capture (MediaProjection): Required to capture display content during active broadcasts.
• Microphone (RECORD_AUDIO): Required to record microphone commentary for your stream.
• Camera (CAMERA): Optional permission used only when you enable the picture-in-picture facecam overlay.
• Display Over Other Apps: Optional permission used to show the floating camera preview while navigating other apps.

Privacy & Data Safety:
• Direct Connection Only: Video and audio packets flow directly to your designated RTMP server. No third-party proxy or intermediary server is used.
• Zero Data Harvesting: No personal identifiable information (PII), stream keys, or device identifiers are collected or tracked.
• No Account Required: Full functionality without accounts, sign-ups, or subscriptions.
• Sandboxed Local Storage: All preferences and stream settings are saved securely on your local device.

### Detailed Overview & Capabilities
LashGage is an offline mechanical precision utility engineered for automotive drivetrain builders, transmission technicians, and engine rebuilders. Eliminate manual guesswork when setting differential ring-and-pinion gear backlash, shimming carrier bearings, and staging solid-lifter valve clearances.

GEAR BACKLASH & DIFFERENTIAL CARRIER SHIM CALCULATOR
- Compute required carrier shim thickness changes to bring backlash into manufacturer specification.
- Supports 14.5°, 20.0°, and 25.0° gear tooth pressure angles for Dana, Ford, GM, and aftermarket hypoid gearsets.
- Provides directional left/right carrier shim thickness changes in thousandths of an inch (0.001 in) and hundredths of a millimeter (0.01 mm).
- Interactive dial indicator display showing measured clearance relative to acceptable tolerance bands.

SOLID LIFTER VALVE LASH & THERMAL COLD STAGING
- Accurately determine cold setup valve clearances from hot camshaft manufacturer specifications.
- Metallurgy compensation: All-Iron (Cast Iron block & heads), Mixed (Iron block & Aluminum heads), and All-Aluminum engines.
- Pushrod material expansion compensation (Chromoly/Steel vs Aluminum pushrods).
- Recommended Go / No-Go feeler gauge blade selections for precise valve adjustments.

DIFFERENTIAL RUNOUT & MULTI-POINT RECORDING
- Record 4-point ring gear backlash measurements (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°) to verify total indicator reading (TIR) and detect warped ring gear flanges.
- Local SQLite database log sheet to save differential and cylinder head setups with zero internet permissions.

100% OFFLINE & PRIVACY FIRST
- Zero internet permissions, zero advertising SDKs, and zero telemetry.
- Operates reliably in metal workshops, service bays, and trackside pits without Wi-Fi or cellular service.
- High-contrast Day and Night themes designed for readability under fluorescent shop lights or under-car drop lights.

Engineered with a pure native Android 44.1 kHz PCM audio synthesis engine, PitchGrid produces mathematically pure waveforms in real time with zero latency, zero audible popping, and zero cloud dependencies.

KEY STUDIO FEATURES:

1. REAL-TIME MULTI-WAVEFORM OSCILLATOR
• Sine: Pure fundamental harmonic tone for acoustic calibration and resonance isolation.
• Triangle: Warm, mellow waveform with odd-order harmonics.
• Sawtooth: Rich analog synth harmonic spectrum for filter and gear testing.
• Square: Punchy vintage pulse wave with odd harmonic series.
• Pink Noise: -3 dB/octave acoustic reference noise for room and speaker response calibration.

• Live audio waveform visualizer with phosphor glow persistence.
• Calibrated division reticle grid and real-time amplitude tracking.
• Instant visual feedback of frequency and harmonic shape changes.

3. MICROTONAL & MUSICAL WORKBENCH
• Continuous 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz coverage with smooth logarithmic sweep seekbar.
• Precision sub-Hz nudging (+1, -1, +10, -10, +100, -100 Hz) and direct numerical frequency input.
• Full musical note mapping from C0 to B8 with octave transpositions.
• Microtonal cents fine-tuning dial (-50 to +50 cents) with instant center reset.
• Reference concert pitch calibration: A4 = 440 Hz (Standard), A4 = 432 Hz (Pythagorean / Verdi), A4 = 444 Hz.
• 1-tap harmonic interval transposition: Major 3rd (5:4), Perfect 4th (4:3), Perfect 5th (3:2), Octave (2:1).

4. AUTOMATED FREQUENCY SWEEP & CALIBRATION
• Continuous 20 Hz to 20 kHz automated logarithmic frequency sweep for testing speakers, headphones, and room standing waves.
• Output attenuation control with calibrated decibel (dB) and percentage readout.

5. PRESETS & CALIBRATION VAULT
• Built-in factory benchmarks: 440 Hz Concert Pitch, 432 Hz Natural Tuning, 1 kHz Line Level Reference, 60 Hz Ground Hum, 40 Hz Subwoofer Resonance, and Guitar String Tunings.

• 100% offline-first. Zero internet permissions required.
• Zero telemetry, zero analytics, zero ads.

- **Tagline**: Offline Sheet Metal Punch Clearance & Tonnage Calculator
- **Landing Page**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/swage-die/
- **Direct APK CDN**: https://github.com/eliakimrosil/kimrosil-app-studio/releases/download/v1.1.0-swage-die/swage-die.apk
- **Privacy Policy**: https://apps.kimrosil.com/swage-die/privacy.html
- **Architecture**: 100% Offline Native Android (Zero Telemetry, Zero Third-Party SDKs)
- **Compatibility**: Android 7.0+ (ARM64 / ARMv7)

### Detailed Overview & Capabilities
SwageDie is an offline tooling engineering and fabrication calculator designed for sheet metal fabricators, tool and die makers, press brake operators, and mechanical engineers.

FEATURES & CAPABILITIES

1. PUNCH & DIE CLEARANCE CALCULATOR
- Accurate punch-to-die clearance calculation per side and total die opening for round, rectangular, square, and custom perimeter profiles.
- Pre-calibrated material shear and tensile strengths: Mild Steel (1018/A36), Stainless Steel (304/316), Aluminum (5052-H32 / 6061-T6), Brass (C26000), Copper (C11000), and High Strength Steel (Domex/Hardox), plus custom shop materials.
- Exact punching tonnage (Metric Tons, US Tons, and kN) with automatic stripping force estimation (~15%).
- Recommended straight die land and angular relief draft recommendations.

2. TUBE & SOLID ROD SWAGING ENGINE
- Rotary and push swaging deformation analysis for hollow tubes and solid rods.
- Accurate cross-sectional area reduction percentage, diameter reduction, and diameter ratio.
- Automatic work hardening warning threshold: alerts when reduction per pass exceeds 25%, advising intermediate annealing before cracking occurs.
- True plastic strain deformation force model and die contact length computation.

3. PRESS BRAKE V-DIE SELECTION & TONNAGE
- Air bending tonnage calculation across full workpiece bend length.
- Recommended V-die opening width based on sheet thickness (6t, 8t, 10t, 12t).
- Minimum flange length and internal bend radius validation.
- Telemetry breakdown showing total tonnage and force per meter.

4. REAL-TIME TECHNICAL HUD CANVAS
- Dynamic cross-section schematic illustrating upper punch, sheet metal stock, clearance gaps, and lower die land with relief angle.
- High-precision press load monitor: compares calculated force against active press machine rating with color-coded safety thresholds (Safe, Heavy, Overload).

5. SHOP PRESS & TOOLING PRESETS (SQLITE)
- Register your shop machinery (turret punches, press brakes, rotary swagers, hydraulic presses) with custom tonnage limits.
- Save and load frequently used tooling combinations with 1 tap.
- 1-tap copy of calculation report formatted for shop job travelers.

6. DUAL UNITS & WORKSHOP THEMES
- 1-tap switching between Metric (mm, kN, Metric Tons) and Imperial (inches, psi, US Tons).
- High-contrast Light, Dark (obsidian HUD), and Auto themes for optimal readability in workshop environments.
- 100% offline, zero ads, zero telemetry, zero accounts.

- Local Storage Only: All items, history, and preferences are retained strictly within on-device sandboxed storage.
